title: Performance monitor loses precision with big integers for custom value monitors.
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and affected versions:
- v4.7.1.stable.mono.official [a13da4feb]
- v4.7.2.stable.steam [ed1daf0bf]
- v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9621) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900K CPU @ 3.60GHz (16 threads) - 15.86 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The "Monitor" tab under "Debugging" seems to always display number values as single-precision float values, even if they are explicitly returned as `int` type for custom monitors registered via `Performance.add_custom_monitor()`, which results in loss of precision with large numbers and makes the integer value snap to 2, 4, 8 etc. after a certain point.

Even when returning a `float` type from GDScript, it still loses the precision the same way despite still displaying the proper value when printed out onto a label or anywhere else (since the script type is probably double-precision).

`Performance.get_custom_monitor()` still returns the correct value, so it seems to be the issue with the monitor interface output and not with how the value is stored/passed in the performance monitor.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add a function that returns a large integer value, e.g. 100000000
2. Add a way to increase/decrease this value by 1 for testing
3. Add a custom monitor with it using `Performance.add_custom_monitor()`
4. Start the game, go to "Debugging" -> "Monitor" tab and look for your custom value
5. Increment/decrement it several times and watch which value it displays after each change

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```gdscript
# Will be displayed as 100000008 under the Monitor tab
Performance.add_custom_monitor("custom/test", func(): return 100000005)
```

[monitor-precision-bug_4.7.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31404556/monitor-precision-bug_4.7.zip)
